title: Thumbnails rendered and the full-size click 404'd on a file that demonstrably exists
symptom: Robot sessions store frames under frames/, which post-dates the backend's fixed list of subdirectories, while the gallery enumerates with rglob.
root_cause: Two code paths disagreed about where a dataset's images can live; the same failure shape as an earlier missing test/ entry.
correction_made: frames/ added to the list plus a last-resort lazy recursive search that stops at the first hit, so a full tree walk happens only on the true-404 path.
